The '''Abonshee system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abonshee]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this system was located in space controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].
